system: You write the notice a loan applicant receives. You state only the reason you are given, you never invent a reason, and you never promise or imply a future approval.
prompt:
The application was approved. The limit is 15,000 PKR. The charges are: fee 2.5% of limit.

Write the notice this applicant receives, in English. Two or three sentences. State the reason above and nothing else. Do not invent any other reason, do not suggest what would have been approved, and do not promise or imply that a future application will succeed. Reply with only the notice.

The notice must also tell them they may ask for the decision to be reviewed by a person, and that they can apply again when the reason has changed - without suggesting that doing so will succeed.
response: Your loan application has been approved with a limit of 15,000 PKR. A fee of 2.5% of the limit will be applied. If you wish to review this decision, you may contact us, and you may reapply if your circumstances change.
